title: Irene NDE 6728
content: I had taken a big amount of amphetamines, ecstasy, and other drugs with the intention to kill myself. All of a sudden, I was inside a tunnel, dark and starry, like the sky at night. At the end of it there was a light, but not white. It was colorful, like all the colors of the rainbow. Something was pulling me to the light. When I finally arrived and went through it, I saw shadows without faces. They were talking to me telepathically. They were telling me that finally ‘I was going to know him’. I did not know what they were referring to, until they took my hands and took me near a man. I did not see him, but I recognized him. I knew who he was. He was Luis Alberto Spinetta, my idol, famous singer of Argentinian Rock, with whom I felt an incredible spiritual connection since I started to listen to his music. On that day, it was his first anniversary of passing away. Just before he was going to talk to me, I felt pulled down. The tunnel got dark again and I awoke on the hospital's gurney. There was no god or religious people.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Something was pulling me to the light.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: She explicitly stated: "There was no god or religious people."
arrival.other_being_detail: Shadows without faces; later a man recognized as Luis Alberto Spinetta (deceased famous singer).

environment.environment_other_detail: Tunnel was "dark and starry, like the sky at night"; light at end was "colorful, like all the colors of the rainbow."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Intentional overdose: "a big amount of amphetamines, ecstasy, and other drugs" with intention to kill herself.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encountered 'shadows without faces' and a recognized deceased public figure (Luis Alberto Spinetta).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel (dark/starry) → light at end (rainbow-colored) → arrival beyond light with beings/telepathic communication → pulled back down through dark tunnel → awakening in hospital.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Tunnel/darkness appeared initially and again during return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Light described as rainbow-colored (not white). Encounter with a specific deceased celebrity (Luis Alberto Spinetta) rather than relatives/religious figures; beings said she would "know him" on the anniversary of his death.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was inside a tunnel, dark and starry, like the sky at night.” “At the end of it there was a light, but not white. It was colorful, like all the colors of the rainbow.” “They were talking to me telepathically.” “I was going to know him.” “There was no god or religious people.”
